description: Machi game set: a waiting-time head-game collection. Taiko rhythm (3 songs, nod/left/right head actions judged from the orientation sensor, segmented motion with return-to-centre) plus a 12-question kotowaza proverb quiz across 3 stages answered by turning the head. Scores, best stage and play counts persist between sessions. Merged boutique rebuild of JP15 matsuri-taiko and JP17 kotowaza-quiz.
name: machi-game-set
